“also” is supplied.
“city of palms” renders “city of the palm trees”; “in the south of Arad” renders “in the Negev of Arad,” and “they went” is plural for the Hebrew singular.
“utterly destroyed” renders the verb for devoting to destruction; “the name … was called” renders “he called the name.” “Hormah” sounds like the Hebrew for “destruction.”
“took” follows the Hebrew; the Greek reads that Judah did not take these cities.
“could not drive out” renders “not to dispossess”; “iron chariots” renders “chariotry of iron.”
“they gave” renders the impersonal “people gave”; “promised” renders “said.”
